title: Colourful Scandinavian Dining Room with Blue Walls & Wood Ceiling
description: A green and blue retro-scandi dining room with a wood-panelled ceiling, built-in bookcase, foosball table and a mix of vintage furniture. Full of colour, pattern and character for anyone who loves a maximalist take on Scandinavian style.
altText: Dining room with sage green and sky blue walls, a wood-slat ceiling, a dining table with orange cushions, a built-in wooden bookcase and a foosball table, lit by a white pendant lamp and natural daylight from two windows.
